sinopsis.es: Alex, que está a punto de convertirse en papá por primera vez, descubre unas antiguas fotografías familiares que sugieren la participación de su padre en hechos intrigantes vinculados a la historia de su país. Este hallazgo lo obligará a confrontar sus lealtades familiares y a preguntarse hasta qué punto es posible construir un futuro y su propia paternidad sin enfrentar las sombras del pasado.
sinopsis.en: Alex will soon become a father. In a storage room, he discovers deeply disturbing family photographs. Some suggest his mother’s marital infidelity; others indicate his father, a retired officer, was involved in various acts of violence. Alex’s investigation leads him to a town devastated years before by the violence of the Internal Armed Conflict, where he uncovers his true and intricate family album.
